description: This file contains template classes and helper functions for bitset operations, including a fast iterator to scan for set bits, as part of the ANGLE project.

classes.name: BitSetT
classes.description: A template class representing a fixed-size bitset with various bitwise operations and iterators.

classes.name: IterableBitSet
classes.description: A bitset class derived from std::bitset with an iterator to traverse set bits.

classes.name: BitSet64
classes.description: Alias for a 64-bit bitset, used on 64-bit CPUs.

methods.name: Bit
methods.description: Creates a bitmask with a single bit set at position x.

methods.name: BitSetT::Reference
methods.description: Proxy class for referencing and modifying individual bits.

methods.name: BitSetT::Iterator
methods.description: Iterator class for traversing set bits efficiently.
